程序包 org.bukkit.plugin.messaging

接口 PluginMessageListener

函数接口:
这是一个函数接口, 因此可用作 lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
@FunctionalInterface public interface PluginMessageListener
一个指定通道的一个监听器，将接收从客户端发送的消息的通知.

原文： A listener for a specific Plugin Channel, which will receive notifications of messages sent from a client.

  • 方法详细资料

    • onPluginMessageReceived

      void onPluginMessageReceived(@NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String channel, @NotNull @NotNull Player player, byte @NotNull [] message)
      当PluginMessageSource(插件消息源)在已注册的通道上发送了插件消息调用此方法.

      原文： A method that will be thrown when a PluginMessageSource sends a plugin message on a registered channel.

      Only called for joined players.

      参数:
      channel - 发送消息通过的通道

      原文：Channel that the message was sent through.

      player - 消息来源

      原文：Source of the message.

      message - 发送的原始消息

      原文：The raw message that was sent.

      另请参阅:
      • for a method that is called for both joined and configuring players

    • onPluginMessageReceived

      @Experimental default void onPluginMessageReceived(@NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String channel, @NotNull @NotNull PlayerConnection connection, byte @NotNull [] message)
      A method that will be invoked when a PluginMessageSource sends a plugin message on a registered channel.

      Called for both joined players and players in the configuration stage.

      参数:
      channel - Channel that the message was sent through.
      connection - Source of the message.
      message - The raw message that was sent.
